name: Trend + POC pullback
rules_summary: Bullish: 2 higher highs + 2 higher lows; fixed-range volume profile from last swing low to swing high; wait for pullback to POC and a reaction; buy (mirror for bearish). Stop/target not stated.

name: POC + demand/supply base
rules_summary: Same as S001: POC of the impulse that coincides with the consolidation base = demand/supply zone; enter on return.

name: Accumulation breakout + POC
rules_summary: Consolidation -> volume profile over it -> breakout -> pullback to POC -> continuation, with higher-timeframe bias.

name: Fade value-area extremes
rules_summary: Session profile: price reaches value-area high/low (70% volume), rejects -> trade back to POC. Order-flow confirmation (not testable).

name: Consolidation-manipulation-distribution + POC
rules_summary: Consolidation POC; price sweeps one side (manipulation); expands to the other side (distribution); wait for pullback into the original POC; enter.

name: Definitions only
rules_summary: POC as magnet, HVN/LVN, value area 70%. No trade rules.

name: EMA50/200 + MACD + RSI
rules_summary: EMA50>EMA200 and close>EMA200, MACD(12,26,9) cross up, RSI 50-70 (mirror short RSI 30-50); stop 3 ATR(14) trailing; no target

name: Donchian 10 + ADX
rules_summary: Close crosses above prior 10-bar high, ADX(14)>20, long only; ATR stop/target (2/4 assumed), 20-bar time stop (assumed)

name: EMA200 + MACD below zero
rules_summary: Close>EMA200, MACD cross up below zero, histogram rising; stop lowest low 4 bars; target 1:3; break-even at 50%

name: MACD hist zero cross + volume
rules_summary: MACD(16,26,9) hist crosses above 0, EMA6(vol)>EMA8(vol), vol>0.5x prev; target 2 ATR (assumed), stop 1.5 ATR (assumed), break-even at 69% -> +0.48%

name: UT Bot + ADX + RSI
rules_summary: UT Bot (key 1, ATR 10 assumed) signals, ADX 16-20, RSI>55 long / <45 short; exit on opposite; UT line as stop

name: Supertrend 10/3
rules_summary: Long on up flip, short on down flip, always in market; risk unit 3 ATR

name: Asian range breakout
rules_summary: Asian range 00-07 UTC; first close beyond it 07-10 UTC; stop other side of range; target 1.5R; flat at 16 UTC

name: BB(20
markets: Close beyond band with RSI<30/>70, exit at middle band, stop 2 ATR

name: RSI2 + SMA200
rules_summary: With SMA200 trend: RSI2<10 buy / >90 sell, exit on SMA5 cross, stop 3 ATR

name: FVG retrace
rules_summary: 3-bar gap after strong bar, retrace into gap within 20 bars and close back -> enter; stop beyond gap; target 2R

name: Previous-day high/low sweep
rules_summary: Wick beyond previous day high/low and close back inside -> fade; stop beyond wick; target 2R

name: Pivot S1/R1 bounce
rules_summary: Dip below S1 and close back above -> buy to P (mirror R1); stop half S1-P beyond S1

name: First 4H candle false breakout (5m)
rules_summary: NY time. Mark high/low of the day's first 4H candle (after it closes). On 5m: a candle BODY closes outside the range, then a candle closes back inside the same day -> fade it (broke up = short, broke down = long). Entry at re-entry close. Stop at the breakout extreme (or nearest key level if too wide). Target 2R. Multiple trades per day allowed. Claimed 72% win rate.

name: Type 1 dealing range (25 DRT + FVG)
rules_summary: False breakout below consolidation, then expansion higher. Grade dealing range low->high. Long when price retraces to the 25% level AND it overlaps a fair value gap. Targets: 50% level and the range high. Stop not stated (assume below range low). Mirror for shorts assumed.

name: Sweep + HTF POI + IFVG + CISD
rules_summary: 4 conditions, all required: liquidity sweep of a major high/low; price reaches a higher-timeframe POI (FVG/order block on 15m); FVG inverts (IFVG); then CISD (close through the nearest series of opposite candles). Enter on CISD, stop beyond the IFVG, target 1:2.

name: Cup and handle breakout
rules_summary: Edge line where the fall began; rounded bottom back to the edge; small pullback below the edge (handle). Entry on a candle close above the edge. Stop under the handle. Target = cup depth projected from the edge.
